name: ifverse-web
description: Every what-if gets its own world.

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-guest.mjs && next build && node scripts/write-version.mjs out
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/copy-guest.mjs && NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK=staging NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_WALLET=1 next build && rm -rf out-staging && mv out out-staging && node scripts/write-version.mjs out-staging staging
scripts.build:rehearsal: node scripts/copy-guest.mjs && NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK=rehearsal NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_WALLET=1 next build && rm -rf out-rehearsal && mv out out-rehearsal && node scripts/write-version.mjs out-rehearsal rehearsal
scripts.build:fixtures: NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK=testnet NEXT_PUBLIC_FIXTURES=1 next build && rm -rf out-fixtures && mv out out-fixtures && node scripts/write-version.mjs out-fixtures testnet
scripts.build:live: NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK=sandbox NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_WALLET=1 next build && rm -rf out-live && mv out out-live && node scripts/write-version.mjs out-live sandbox
scripts.build:demo: NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK=testnet NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_WALLET=1 next build && rm -rf out-demo && mv out out-demo && node scripts/write-version.mjs out-demo testnet
